**memory-gate receives the PR context, reads the default branch and honors skip:memory-gate per tier (#1024)**

**What**: The GitHub memory-gate job now passes VCS_TOKEN/PR_NUMBER/PR_BODY, so the issue-scoped memoryRetrieval() runs in CI. Scoped evidence is the union of the PR tree and the default branch (default-branch-records.mjs: git ls-tree + cat-file --batch, no checkout; targeted --depth=1 fetch only on a shallow checkout), so a record that reached main on its lane PR satisfies the gate without a rebase. skip:memory-gate is real and follows TIER_PARAMS: honored at standard when applied by someone other than the PR author and outside reviewActors/agentActors, refused at regulated, noted at lite. Every run names its path (presence, retrieval, skipped, uncomputable) and every refusal reason is visible. brain-metrics counts honored overrides and reads MR label events on GitLab.
**Why**: GATE_MATRIX already ratified issue-linked evidence at standard/regulated but the workflow never delivered the PR body; the #529 ruling required the override before tightening.
**Where**: .github/workflows/governance.yml, brain/scripts/governance/{run-check.mjs,default-branch-records.mjs,memory-gate-override.mjs}, brain/scripts/vcs/providers/{github,gitlab}.mjs, brain/scripts/brain-metrics.mjs, contributor-scaffold.mjs and both PR templates, openspec/changes/issue-1024-memory-gate-pr-context/.
**Learned**: git fetch --depth=1 on a full clone writes .git/shallow and grafts history; tests reached it from the real repo and cut history for every worktree until repaired. A suite that passes with the network blocked proves nothing about side effects; a git spy on PATH does. brain:check diffSize only measures commits.
